summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue of `ax.bar` raising an exception when passed only NaN data, but it introduces non-minimal changes and lacks comprehensive testing.

issues.description: The patch includes additional exception handling for `StopIteration` that is not directly related to the original issue, potentially introducing unnecessary complexity.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify that the fix works correctly for the specific case of all-NaN data, nor does it ensure that other edge cases are handled appropriately.
